title: Resolution Sensitivity of Attention-Entropy OOD Detection in Vision Transformers: A Controlled Bidirectional Analysis — Science-Lock Major Revision Release
description: Science-lock software and replication release for Pattern Recognition manuscript PR-D-26-04876 R1. This patch preserves all primary estimates and prelocked gate statuses from v2.0.0, adds the complete eight-cell Layer-4 paired-direction correlation diagnostic, records the shared-seed nuisance interpretive boundary used in the final revision, and points to PR_MAJOR_REVISION_REPLICATION_v0.3.4. The original E6 random-PE prespecified replication gate remains failed; the harmonized fixed-PE result remains a narrower post-audit estimand and is not presented as a retroactive gate pass.
